scope: Cubical Agda: the gathering of all n-types is an (n+1)-type (library); exactly one level up at the first two rungs: the gathering of all sets is not a set, the gathering of all groupoids is not a groupoid (rotating the circle once is a non-trivial loop of self-equivalences); truncating the gathering of sets cannot be undone by any decoding map.
